title: [GMCP 203.016.05] Interoperability and quality: First-class extension framework and extension governance
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-016-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Namespaced MCP extensions can be discovered, negotiated, configured, versioned, isolated and disabled through one typed framework without forking core protocol code. Unknown extensions round-trip safely, required unsupported extensions fail explicitly, official and experimental status is visible, collision and downgrade rules are enforced, and a watch process opens roadmap work for every newly published official extension. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
